_doc: Gen-DEPTH probe for v2ecoli: ONE lineage run 16 generations deep, to test whether the single-process lineage runner stays healthy (divides every gen, no in-process state-accumulation blowup) at the depth the 8x16 equivalence run needs. Depth is independent of seed count, so 1 seed isolates the risk cheaply (~1 hr). MUST use the full-ParCa cache (out/cache_full); the fast cache is FBA-broken and won't divide past gen 0. Watch: all 16 gens divide with sane cycle times; the doubling-time/size drift plateaus rather than running away.
